name: AIM
recent: 公司于2026年10月30日发布2026财年年报，核数师对持续经营能力出具重大不确定性意见。此前，执行董事Chou Sing Hoan于2026年9月25日行使ESOS期权，涉及80,065,016股新股。公司将于2026年12月11日召开第22届常年股东大会。
notable: 核数师对公司持续经营能力出具重大不确定性意见。
执行董事Chou Sing Hoan行使ESOS期权，涉及80,065,016股新股，占16.004%。
公司将于2026年12月11日召开第22届常年股东大会。
risks: 核数师对持续经营能力出具重大不确定性意见。
执行董事通过行使ESOS期权增持16.004%股份，导致现有股东权益被摊薄。
earnings: 2026财年（截至6月30日）营收为763,000令吉，净亏损5,067,000令吉，净亏损率为664.1%。营收环比下降59.1%，同比下降56.0%。

recent_en: The company released its FY2026 annual report on 30 October 2026, with the auditor issuing a material uncertainty related to going concern. Earlier, Executive Director Chou Sing Hoan exercised ESOS options on 25 September 2026 involving 80,065,016 new shares.
notable_en: The auditor issued a material uncertainty related to going concern.
Executive Director Chou Sing Hoan exercised ESOS options involving 80,065,016 new shares, representing 16.004%.
risks_en: The auditor issued a material uncertainty related to going concern.
The Executive Director increased his shareholding by 16.004% through ESOS exercise, diluting existing shareholders.
earnings_en: For FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was RM763,000 with a net loss of RM5,067,000, a net loss margin of 664.1%. Revenue fell 59.1% QoQ and 56.0% YoY.
